title: 1983 AHSME Problem 10
statement: Segment \(AB\) is both a diameter of a circle of radius \(1\) and a side of an equilateral triangle \(ABC.\) The circle also intersects \(AC\) and \(BC\) at points \(D\) and \(E,\) respectively. The length of \(AE\) is

solutions.text:
Since \(E\) is on the circle with diameter \(AB,\) \(\angle AEB=90^\circ.\) Also \(\angle ABE=60^\circ\) because \(ABC\) is equilateral. Thus \(ABE\) is a \(30^\circ\)-\(60^\circ\)-\(90^\circ\) triangle with hypotenuse \(AB=2,\) so \(AE=\sqrt3.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is D.
hints: Because \(AB\) is a diameter, \(\angle AEB\) is a right angle
